# Nounsmith

> Nounsmith is a word-riddle game for iPhone, coming soon to the App Store. Each page is a plate: a riddle sentence set in wood type above a two-colour printed picture, and the words and the things trade places.

- Make: drag a word from the sentence into the picture and the thing appears there (RAIN on the sky, and it rains on the garden).
- Take: drag a thing from the picture up into a gap in the sentence and it is gone from the picture.
- Respell: drop a loose letter on a word and the thing changes with it (a G on BOAT makes a GOAT). From the third chapter a letter can also be slipped in or pulled out.
- A wrong word goes wrong (an Oops: the cat gets soaked); an Eraser takes the move back. A Quill outlines the next move. No timer, no lives.
- 40 hand-made pages in four chapters: The Cottage (free), The Harbour, The Market, The Lighthouse.
- One one-time purchase, The Whole Book, opens chapters 2 to 4 and adds five Quills; an optional consumable pack, Inkwell, holds 12 Quills and 6 Erasers. No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no account; plays offline. English.
- Made by Luong Nguyen.
